board: Adafruit STEMMA Reflective Photo Interrupt Sensor - TCRT1000 (product 5913)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB). Modelled as an open-drain digital sensor: the TCRT1000 phototransistor collector is SIG with a 10 kOhm board pull-up to VIN, low when IR is reflected. The request's #5629 is actually the FeatherS2 Neo; the real product ID is 5913.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-stemma-reflective-photo-interrupt-sensor/pinouts plus the Adafruit fab print https://cdn-learn.adafruit.com/assets/assets/000/129/124/large1024/sensors_fab.png (header SIG, VIN, GND)
